summary: Full frontend E2E validation of the redesigned Mitra.Mobil landing (DriveX-style), catalog filters, mobile responsiveness, detail page, admin panel and consignment lifecycle (submit jual -> UI approve -> visible in Bekas/Populer, NOT in Beli). All 9 items from the review request validated on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/app/admin/page.tsx is 680+ lines; consider splitting into (Dashboard, Booking, Armada, Titip Mobil) subcomponents to improve maintainability.
consignmentToCarItem() in /app/app/lib/consignment-types.ts hardcodes seats:5 and rating:5 for every titipan; add these fields to Consignment schema so real values are shown.
search-fields wrapper has no data-testid (only className='search-fields expanded'). Add data-testid='search-fields' to make the mobile-filter-collapse test target stable.
Prototype storage is a JSON file /app/data/consignments.json — not concurrency-safe. Add a file lock or move to MongoDB before production.
GET /api/consignments is called on every home page render; add ISR/cache headers or Next.js revalidate to reduce disk I/O.
Public GET /api/consignments returns full owner phone (whatsapp) and plate — consider redacting sensitive fields for anonymous callers.
seed_data_creation: Two new consignments submitted via UI and approved via admin UI: titip-mumgu4tn-hod2i (Toyota TESTJUAL-73614, jual, 165jt, APPROVED) and titip-mumgx3rq-2ev8s (Honda UITEST-73749, jual, 180jt, APPROVED). Pre-existing test data preserved: titip-muhm9g1o-057ny (sewa APPROVED), titip-muhm4t2y-kusum (sewa APPROVED), titip-muhm4t6z-lcyv6 (jual REJECTED).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs via supervisor 'frontend' on port 3000 (Next.js dev). No separate backend. Test at http://localhost:3000 directly. Admin login: admin@autohunt.local/admin123. Consignments persist in /app/data/consignments.json. Approved jual consignments appear only under mode-tab-bekas (and category-tab-populer/bekas), NOT under mode-tab-beli. Approved sewa consignments appear under mode-tab-sewa. Buy price for consignments is stored/displayed as raw Rupiah (formatShortRupiah 'Rp 165 jt') with no conversion. Bekas count = 3 static cars (Alphard, CR-V, Panther) + approved jual consignments. Beli count = 14 New Car static cars only. Sewa count = 17 static + approved sewa consignments (currently 4 approved sewa titipan available). Detailed test results captured; playwright ran against http://localhost:3000. Mobile viewport 390x844 verified no horizontal overflow on /, /titip-mobil, /cars/*, /admin/login (admin dashboard mobile has sidebar off-canvas; body width still <=390).
